data.define: Used for things with a beautiful, matching look.

misuse.text: Don't call your messy room 'aesthetic' to Mom.
misuse.why: It only fits stylish, pretty things.

native.tip: “aesthetic” = estetis; estetik. Contoh: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “aesthetic”?

Contoh: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.” (Meja kamu terlihat sangat "aesthetic".)
